changeSet.author: str-backend
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO str_rn.accommodation_activity ( activity_id, platform_id, rn, accommodation_id, period_from, period_to, overnight_stays, guest_count, received_at, purge_after ) WITH months AS ( SELECT period_from::date AS period_from, (period_from + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date AS period_to, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY period_from)::int AS month_idx FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-12-01', DATE '2026-05-01', INTERVAL '1 month') AS period_from ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), p.platform_id, rn.rn, rn.accommodation_id, m.period_from, m.period_to, CASE WHEN p.name = 'Airbnb' THEN 5 + (m.month_idx * 3) ELSE 3 + (m.month_idx * 2) END, CASE WHEN p.name = 'Airbnb' THEN 2 + m.month_idx ELSE 1 + m.month_idx END, (m.period_to + INTERVAL '1 day')::timestamptz, ((m.period_to + INTERVAL '1 day')::timestamptz + INTERVAL '18 months') FROM str_rn.registration_number rn CROSS JOIN str_rn.online_platform p CROSS JOIN months m WHERE rn.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.name IN ('Airbnb', 'Booking.com');

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM str_rn.accommodation_activity WHERE period_from >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND period_to <= DATE '2026-05-31'
